name: rosetta-compare-length-of-two-strings
code:
use default

report(words: string[]) is
    let longest_first =
        words |> sort((left, right) => right.length - left.length)

    for word in longest_first do
        write_line("{word} has length {word.length}")
    od
si

report(["abcd", "123456789"])

write_line("")

report(["abcd", "123456789", "abcdef", "1234567"])
